messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Change to weekly meeting time and day
parts:
I think he meant Tuesdays. That'll be 1 AM Wednesday for me, which
I can make.

Most everyone's feature requests are reasonable --- it's just a
matter of prioritizing what we want to do and finishing one thing
before starting the next.

Personally, I think I'll spend another week working on error handling.
I just massively cleaned up the parser errors to be much more localized
and informative as to what the parser expected and how to fix it.
I'm going to work on getting line numbers into run time errors that
get thrown during warmup/sampling. After that, I'd like to finish the
general slicing syntax a la MATLAB/R. That may take another couple of
weeks to get it all done and tested. Then after that, I'm free as a bird,
though I should really be helping out with getting the higher-order
autodiff in shape.

- Bob
